summary: The filing is a Form 8-K reporting results of operations and financial condition (Item 2.02) and declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share (Item 8.01). It includes a press release summarizing first quarter 2026 financial results with net sales down 6% year-over-year and a net loss of $4.3 million. The dividend is payable on June 29, 2026 to shareholders of record on May 29, 2026. This is a routine earnings announcement and dividend declaration, with no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other event listed in the category options.
